column1: Polynnomials of degree 1, 2 and 3 are called linear, quadratic and cubic polynomials respectively.
Linear Polynomial: Degree 1 (Graph is straight Line)
Quadratic Polynomial: Degree 2 (Graph is Curve, open upward or downward, called parabola)

column2: Case 1: Parabola cut X axis at 2 points. These 2 values of x are Zeros of Polynomial
Case 2: Parabola touch X axis at one point. There the 2 Zeros of polynomial coincide and make only 1 point. Thus has 1 Zero of polynomial
Case 3: Parabola is above or below X axis. Thus this is no Zero polynomial
